description: If no MSS option is received at connection setup, DUT defaults send MSS to 536 bytes (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.6 p85)
approach:
[Objective]
The spec default. Without an explicit MSS, RFC 1122 §4.2.2.6 says assume 536 (the largest path MTU minus headers that's universally safe).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake without MSS option.
2. DUT → Tester: data segment.
3. Observation: data segment size = 536 bytes.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted segment size = 536.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_segment_size — segment is not 536 bytes
• Fail_timeout — no DUT data segment

verdicts.Fail_wrong_segment_size: DUT data segment size not default 536
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT data segment within listen window
